title: FLY ONE ROUNDTRIP WITH SOUTHWEST AIRLINES OVER THE HOLIDAYS AND EARN A PROMOTIONAL COMPANION PASS
summary: Rapid Rewards Members can book a qualifying trip during Southwest's three-day Black Friday offer to earn a promotional…...
body_markdown:
*Rapid Rewards Members can book a qualifying* *trip during Southwest's three-day Black Friday offer to earn a promotional Companion Pass for early 2027*


DALLAS


, Nov. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Southwest Airlines Co.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=1301290774&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3Fsrc%3DPRPRPRNCPPRCompan261127&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co.) (NYSE: LUV) is rewarding Customers who travel this season with[a limited-time Black Friday offer](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=2143184439&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2Frapid-rewards%2Fcompanion-pass-promotion%2F&a=a+limited-time+Black+Friday+offer) that gives Rapid Rewards® Members the opportunity to earn a promotional Companion Pass® after completing one qualifying roundtrip flight or two qualifying one-way flights for travel between November 27, 2026, and January 5, 2027.1


Companion Pass is one of the most valued benefits in travel, giving Rapid Rewards Members the ability to designate one person to fly with them free1 every time the Member purchases or redeems points for a qualifying flight.


**To qualify, Rapid Rewards Members must:**


- [Register for the promotion](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=2635623054&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2Frapid-rewards%2Fcompanion-pass-promotion%2F&a=Register+for+the+promotion) and purchase one qualifying roundtrip flight or two qualifying one-way flights from Nov. 27 through Nov. 29, 2026;
- Complete all qualifying travel by Jan. 5, 2027 (no blackout dates); and
- Designate a Companion to fly free1 with them on qualifying flights from Jan. 8 through March 3, 2027.


"We're grateful every time a Member chooses Southwest, especially for trips that bring people together over the holidays," said Nandika Suri, Vice President of Rapid Rewards. "This Companion Pass offer is a way to thank our loyal Members for traveling with us this season, while inviting newer Members to discover the value of Rapid Rewards through one of our most coveted benefits, the Companion Pass."


**Wait, There's More**


Those who apply for a Southwest Rapid Rewards® Credit Card by December 14, 2026, are approved, and meet the spending requirements for the new Cardmember welcome bonus will have the opportunity to have those points count towards a Companion Pass valid through December 31, 2027. This applies even if the spend requirement is met in early 2027.2


[See more details and how to apply for the card offer here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=2166489497&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2Frapid-rewards%2Fpartners%2Fcredit-cards%2Fconsumer-cards%2F&a=See+more+details+and+how+to+apply+for+the+card+offer+here) .


**More to Love from Rapid Rewards**
Southwest offers Rapid Rewards Members access to free WiFi thanks to T-Mobile®, including ultra-fast Starlink WiFi.3 Customers can join Rapid Rewards to unlock access to free WiFi, tier benefits, and points by flying qualifying flights or spending with eligible partners. All Rapid Rewards rules and regulations apply at[Southwest.com/rrterms](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=289793592&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2Fabout-southwest%2Fterms-and-conditions%2Frapid-rewards%2F&a=Southwest.com%2Frrterms) .


**ABOUT SOUTHWEST AIRLINES CO.**


[Southwest Airlines Co.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=1301290774&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3Fsrc%3DPRPRPRNCPPRCompan261127&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co.) operates one of the world's most admired and awarded airlines, offering its one-of-a-kind value and Hospitality at 121 airports across 12 countries. Southwest took flight in 1971 to democratize the sky through friendly, reliable, and low-cost air travel and now carries more air travelers flying within the United States than any other airline.4 By empowering its more than 73,000 *5* People to deliver unparalleled Hospitality, the maverick airline cherishes a passionate loyalty among more than 134 million Customers carried in 2025. Southwest leverages a unique legacy and mission to serve communities around the world including harnessing the power of its People and Purpose to put communities at the Heart of its success. Learn more by visiting[Southwest.com/citizenship](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831673-1&h=2851095315&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2Fcitizenship%2F&a=Southwest.com%2Fcitizenship) .


*1* *Does not include taxes and fees from $5.60 one-way* ***.*** *Must include Rapid Rewards number during booking. Limited time. Restrictions apply. Qualifying flight(s) must be flown by the same Member.* *2* *Terms apply.* *Companion Pass® qualifying points are earned from revenue flights booked through Southwest®, points earned on Rapid Rewards® Credit Cards, and base points earned from Rapid Rewards loyalty partners. The following do not count as Companion Pass qualifying points: purchased points; points transferred between Members; points converted from hotel and car loyalty programs, e-Rewards®, Valued Opinions, and Diners Club®; points earned from Rapid Rewards program enrollment, tier bonus points; flight bonus points; and partner bonus points (with the exception of the Rapid Rewards Credit Cards from Chase). Neither points nor tier or Companion Pass qualifying points will be awarded for flights taken by the Companion when flying on a Companion Pass reservation. Points earned during a billing cycle on a Southwest Airlines Rapid Rewards Credit Card from Chase are not available for redemption or qualification for Companion Pass status until they are posted on your billing statement and posted to your Rapid Rewards account.* *3* *Where available. Available only on WiFi-enabled designated aircraft.* *4* *Based on Southwest Airlines' analysis of Cirium Diio data. Southwest Airlines carried the most passengers within the United States between January and August 2026 (latest month available), as of 11/23/2026.* *5* *Fulltime-equivalent active Employees as of June 30, 2026.*
